scope: Final-catalog follow-up for six missing Dungeon HeroClassHOMM6 rows, nullable existing creature growth fields, one fully transcribed Spectral Dragon profile, and the remaining Heroes VI creature-detail blockers.
policy: No game installation was downloaded, no live database was changed, and no existing non-null value was overwritten. All numeric values in this file are candidates only: the public sources are secondary transcriptions or conflict with one another. Merge only after a primary original-game table, final editor package, or retained game-file extraction corroborates the exact value and final patch scope.

supports: The Darkblade and Sorcerer pages print initial six-attribute tables.
The four promoted-class pages identify Shadow Slayer/Trickster as Darkblade Blood/Tears and Dark Prophet/Shadow Weaver as Sorcerer Blood/Tears.
This is cross-language wiki evidence, not independent primary evidence; all six class rows remain candidate-only.
The dated Haven table prints Sentinel/Praetorian 9/14 and Sister/Vestal 7/11 weekly growth.

The dated Dungeon table prints Assassin/Shade 7/11, Stalker/Chakram Dancer 7/10, Shadow Lurker/Shadow Watcher 6/9, Minotaur/Minotaur Guard 3/4, Manticore/Scorpicore 4/5, Faceless/Faceless Puppeteer 3/5, and Shadow Dragon/Black Dragon 1/2.
These explicit nullable growth candidates are not mergeable as primary facts until checked against final game/editor data.
Heroes VI uses hidden integer creature defense values and displays derived resistance percentages.
A displayed percentage cannot be copied into MightDefense or MagicDefense; integer inversion is safe only when unique.
sources.notes: Published fan manual 0.921, not an official Ubisoft package; already cited by the repository's existing Heroes VI research.

supports: The Russian H6 page prints raw 27/28 defense points, 55-61 damage, 315 health, 45 initiative, speed 7 with flying movement, Large size, no range, luck 7, morale 0, and weekly growth 1.
Its footnote says the cost and growth are present in the game files even though the creature is not recruitable in ordinary play.
The existing generic row and prior research classify Spectral Dragon as a Necropolis summoned creature.

supports: Russian pages print Shadow Lurker and Shadow Watcher Magic Defense as 10.5 (22%), while the Japanese table prints integer 11 (22%).
The conflict is retained as evidence-only; no detail row is added and no existing scalar is overwritten.
Ubisoft's published Heroes VI 2.1 notes include creature-specific and ability-specific fixes, including Ahribban, Imperial Griffin, Dreamwalker, and Blazing Glory.
The final patch history is version-sensitive, but the public notes do not publish the missing boss raw fields.
